_comment: Synthetic Slack-user roster for the SCRM localized-brief demo (the analog of demo-data/vha/demo_roster.json). Each entry is the SUBSET of a real users.info payload the resolvers read (id, tz, locale, profile.title, profile.fields). It lets scrmRiskBrief.js exercise the (ROLE x PORTFOLIO) parameterization in dry-run WITHOUT live Slack users. In production these come straight from users.info; this file is never used when a bot token is present unless SCRM_BRIEF_USE_ROSTER=1. Chosen so the SAME flagged alerts produce DIFFERENT briefs by role and portfolio: a program director sees everything, a portfolio owner sees all KRIs in one lane, an analyst sees one KRI. Josh is the program-office director (persona: military SCRM director based in Phoenix) and gets the full program-wide brief.

users._persona: Program-office SCRM director for a military supply-chain risk program, based in Phoenix, AZ.
users._expect: ALL portfolios x ALL KRIs -> program-wide brief (top flagged supplier x KRI risks across all 5 portfolios)
ICT Hardware (owner id) x ALL KRIs -> that lane's flagged risks (incl. the FOCI/cyber cluster: Meridian Microelectronics, etc.)
ALL portfolios x CYBER only -> cyber-posture alerts program-wide (role filtering)
Logistics & Sustainment x DELIVERY only -> the fresh Yellow->Red delivery breaches in that lane (role x portfolio intersection)
